item.description: Overview Address: 10.14.140.127 This Lab was created for myself and everyone in my teamtontac to research and learn about security vulnerabilities and develop ourselves. 1 – Exploit the Java Deserialization vulnerability on port 8081 to get the datmom shell 2 – From datmom, escape the python sandbox to escalate to root. item.title: [Java Deserialization] CommonsBeanutils1 exploit chain analysis
item.author: quactv
item.description: Vulnerabilities related to deserialization in Java have become a hot security topic in recent years. An unsafe deserialization process can lead to serious vulnerabilities such as remote code execution. Ysoserial is a project created by frohoff, one of the people who discovered deserialization vulnerabilities in Java. This post will analyze the CommonsBeanutils1 chain Apache Commons Beanutils is another project in the Apache Commons toolkit that provides some methods for manipulating ordinary Java class objects (also known as JavaBeans).

item.title: [Java Deserialization] A discussion of the Serialize and Deserialize mechanism in Java
item.author: quactv
item.description: Security vulnerabilities related to Java Deserialization (Deser) are hard for me. I spent a lot of time learning about it. And I didn’t stop. I want to learn new things and dig deeper into it. In this first post I’ll explain the Serialize and Deserialize mechanism in Java. It’s really just like notes I’m writing down for what I’ve learned. I truly admire some of the seniors before me who have done deep research on this vulnerability and have many complex CVEs related to it: Jangg, Quynh Le.
